description: Source code for chart action handlers in Superset frontend, including data fetching, annotation queries, chart updates, and related Redux actions.

methods.name: chartUpdateStarted
methods.description: Creates an action indicating the start of a chart data update, including abort controller and form data.

methods.name: chartUpdateSucceeded
methods.description: Creates an action indicating successful chart data fetch with response data.

methods.name: chartUpdateStopped
methods.description: Creates an action indicating that chart data update has been stopped.

methods.name: chartUpdateFailed
methods.description: Creates an action indicating failure in chart data fetch with error response.

methods.name: chartRenderingFailed
methods.description: Creates an action indicating chart rendering failure with error details.

methods.name: chartRenderingSucceeded
methods.description: Creates an action indicating chart rendering success.

methods.name: removeChart
methods.description: Creates an action to remove a chart by key.

methods.name: annotationQuerySuccess
methods.description: Creates an action for successful annotation data fetch.

methods.name: annotationQueryStarted
methods.description: Creates an action indicating start of annotation query.

methods.name: annotationQueryFailed
methods.description: Creates an action for failed annotation query.

methods.name: dynamicPluginControlsReady
methods.description: Dispatches controls state for dynamic plugin controls.

methods.name: triggerQuery
methods.description: Dispatches an action to trigger a chart query.

methods.name: renderTriggered
methods.description: Dispatches an action for forced re-render without data fetch.

methods.name: updateQueryFormData
methods.description: Dispatches an action to update chart query form data.

methods.name: updateChartId
methods.description: Dispatches an action to update chart's slice ID.

methods.name: addChart
methods.description: Dispatches an action to add a new chart.

methods.name: handleChartDataResponse
methods.description: Processes server response for chart data, handling synchronous, asynchronous, and error states.

methods.name: exploreJSON
methods.description: Main function to fetch chart data, handle annotations, and dispatch related actions.

methods.name: postChartFormData
methods.description: Wrapper to initiate chart data fetch with current form data.

methods.name: redirectSQLLab
methods.description: Fetches SQL query and redirects to SQL Lab interface.

methods.name: refreshChart
methods.description: Triggers re-fetching of chart data based on latest form data.

methods.name: getDatasourceSamples
methods.description: Fetches sample data for a datasource.

methods.name: runAnnotationQuery
methods.description: Performs annotation data query with timeout and dispatches success or failure actions.
